plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Run Codex as a subagent from Claude Code: rights declared per call, the network on by default at both levels and off by one line, exit codes derived from evidence, a receipt per completed turn. Adds an orchestration mode over Claude and Codex seats, and an approved cleanup.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Two user-invoked skills for documentation. The first measures it: fresh readers answer the questions your readers arrive with, and every claim about behaviour is checked against the code that backs it. The second repairs what broke, through a small bake-off judged on those measured failures, and proposes the result without touching your files.
